summary: The proposal exceeds the allowed page length and provides an insufficient bibliography, both critical deficiencies. Minor style issues (filler word, forbidden sentence starter) and a suggestion to clarify that a UML diagram is included were also noted. Addressing these points is required before the proposal can be considered acceptable.

findings.title: Proposal exceeds length limits
findings.description: The proposal exceeds the allowed total length of 4-6 pages of main text, spanning 12 pages overall.

findings.title: Insufficient bibliography entries
findings.description: The bibliography contains only five entries; the guidelines require at least 6-8 peer‑reviewed publications.

findings.title: Filler word 'Additionally'
findings.description: The word 'Additionally' is used as a filler at the start of a sentence, which the guidelines advise avoiding.

locations.quote: Additionally, supervisors can provide feedback faster, making the process more scalable.

findings.title: Forbidden starter 'Because'
findings.description: Sentence starts with forbidden starter 'Because', violating style guidelines.

locations.quote: Because the feedback tool is powered by LLMs, students can obtain instant formative feedback at any point during the writing process.

findings.title: Unclear UML diagram
findings.description: Figure caption does not explicitly state that it is a UML diagram; ensure at least one figure is a clearly labeled UML diagram.
